data.label: Customer Trust
data.title:
5 things customers check
*before calling you*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site is ready →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Does it *look good* on mobile?
data.body: Most local customers search on their phones. If your site is hard to read or zooms in/out, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone and click every button.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Your *hours and location*
data.body: People need to know if you are open and nearby. If they have to hunt for this, they will choose a competitor.
data.fix: Fix: Put your address and hours in the website footer.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Proof of *quality work*
data.body: Customers want to see what you actually do. Real photos of your work build instant trust faster than any text.
data.fix: Fix: Add a gallery showing 5 recent, high-quality projects.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: An *easy way* to contact
data.body: If your phone number isn't clickable, you are losing leads. Make it one tap to call or book.
data.fix: Fix: Add a giant 'Call Now' button at the top.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Clear *service list*
data.body: Don't make them guess what you offer. If your services aren't clear, they won't waste time asking.
data.fix: Fix: List your top 3 services clearly on the homepage.
